title: NBN services in Mosman (NSW) – planned maintenance
current_summary: Planned maintenance will affect NBN services in the Mosman area (NSW) while a network provider performs service migration work. The window is 11:00 pm on 14 Oct 2026 to 6:00 am on 15 Oct 2026 (AEDT). Services may experience interruptions during the window (up to seven hours).

updates.content: Scheduled maintenance: A network provider will be performing service migration work affecting NBN services in the Mosman area. Window: 11:00 pm 14 Oct 2026 to 6:00 am 15 Oct 2026 (AEDT). Impact: NBN services delivered via the Mosman area may experience interruptions during the window (up to seven hours). We will provide an update when work begins and when it is complete.
